subject: mathematics
title: Fraction Models
objective: Represent fractions equal to one or greater than one using equal parts.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ A fraction names equal parts. A fraction equal to one has the same numerator and denominator; a fraction greater than one has a larger numerator. Ready to explore?
